crossRefs.note: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses…
“You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine…
He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;
I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail…
God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of…
He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;
for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

translations.web: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
translations.bsb: Set up the surrounding courtyard and hang the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the hanging at the court gate.
translations.asv: And thou shalt set up the court round about, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.
